A 72-years-old Caucasian male was admitted with acute onset of dysarthria, dysphagia and trismus three years after initial surgical treatment for bladder cancer.
He died about one year after diagnosis of PERM.
Cytostatic treatment was initiated after the second course of immunoglobulin therapy which was three months after onset of neurological symptoms.
The patient developed increasing dysphagia, dysarthria, lockjaw and painful face spasms.
